evals.name: cold-start-orientation
evals.prompt: I just connected Dreambase. Which of my customers signed up in the last 30 days and how does that compare to the 30 days before?
evals.expected_output: The agent orients before querying: whoami, then list_workspaces, then list_datasets to find a signups-shaped dataset and read its real column names, then a single aggregating query_dataset SELECT over the table `dataset` that returns two bucketed counts rather than raw rows. It asks which workspace when more than one comes back, and reports the answer in prose naming the dataset it used.
assertions: The agent calls whoami before any workspace-scoped tool
The agent calls list_workspaces and uses a returned workspace id rather than inventing one
The agent inspects dataset columns via list_datasets or get_dataset before writing SQL
The query_dataset SQL selects FROM dataset (the literal staged table name), not from the dataset's display name
The SQL aggregates (GROUP BY / count / date bucketing) instead of pulling raw rows for the agent to count
Exactly one SELECT statement is sent per query_dataset call
If more than one workspace is returned, the agent asks which to use instead of picking silently
The final answer names the dataset the numbers came from

evals.name: truncated-result-recovery
evals.prompt: Break down last quarter's orders by region and product category from the orders dataset in my Acme workspace. My first attempt just did SELECT * FROM dataset and came back truncated.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the truncation as a query-shape problem, not a transient failure: it rewrites the query to aggregate in SQL (GROUP BY region, category with a count/sum) and filter to last quarter, rather than re-issuing SELECT * or paging blindly through thousands of rows. It never presents a truncated sample as the complete breakdown.
assertions: The agent does not re-issue the same unchanged SELECT * query
The replacement query aggregates in SQL rather than fetching raw rows to aggregate client-side
The replacement query narrows the row set with a WHERE clause for the time range
If any result is still truncated, the agent says so explicitly rather than presenting it as complete
The agent does not claim a total or a ranking that the returned rows do not support

evals.name: non-idempotent-write-failure
evals.prompt: Create a Dreambase skill for our subscription revenue domain — MRR, churn, expansion, the usual. (The create_skill call times out with no response after about 90 seconds.)
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the ambiguous timeout as possibly-succeeded: it calls list_skills to check whether a matching skill was in fact created before doing anything else, and does not automatically re-call create_skill. If nothing matches, it surfaces the failure to the user with the request text it sent so they can decide, rather than silently retrying.
assertions: The agent does not call create_skill a second time automatically
The agent calls list_skills to check for an already-created matching skill
The agent explains that create_skill is not idempotent and a retry could create a duplicate
If no matching skill exists, the agent surfaces the failure and the request text to the user instead of retrying blind
The agent does not report success it did not observe

evals.name: health-report-async-and-permissions
evals.prompt: Run a fresh database health check on our production Supabase connection and tell me the grade.
evals.expected_output: The agent discovers the connection via list_connections (rather than guessing an id), checks list_health_reports for a recent report first, then calls create_health_report and polls get_health_report until status is terminal — telling the user it is generating instead of waiting silently or reporting the 'generating' response as the result. A FORBIDDEN or CONFLICT is explained rather than retried.
assertions: The agent calls list_connections to obtain the Supabase connection id
The agent polls get_health_report after create_health_report rather than treating the create response as the finished report
The agent does not present status 'generating' as a completed result or invent a grade
The agent does not call create_health_report again while one is generating
A CONFLICT is handled by polling the in-flight report, and a FORBIDDEN is explained as a role problem rather than retried
